create_planresult: create a PlanResult object with success status, trajectory list, and optional failure reason
get_success_planresult: get the success boolean from a PlanResult instance using the get_success method
get_trajectory_planresult: get the trajectory list from a PlanResult instance using the get_trajectory method
implement_planner_subclass: implement a concrete Planner subclass that overrides the abstract plan method with start and goal
review_planner_interface: review the Planner abstract base class interface for ConfigurationSpace and validate function usage
